answer: Require every identity to lock value in a time-locked bond that unlocks only after diverse peers verify genuine, varied work. Compare timing, language, and social links; clones acting together form a nebula of identical traces and share the loss of their unvested bond at the nadir of detection. A sybil operator thus pays for every clone and cannot hide by splitting one effort across names; the reef of clustered behavior exposes the whole group, making marginal clone cost scale with swarm size.
